tex_content.html:
\begin{example} \end{example}[Viscous Burgers' equation via the Hopf--Cole transformation] ↗ ex:hopf-cole-quadratic-nonlinearity ↗ def:integral-solution-conservation-law 1. ch4:4.4.1-ex-2\group Nonlinear to Linear PDE

For viscous Burgers, \[ u_t-au_{xx}+uu_x=0,\qquad u(x,0)=g(x), \] set $w(x,t)=\int _{-\infty }^xu(y,t)\, dy$ and $h(x)=\int _{-\infty }^xg(y)\, dy$. Then $w_t-aw_{xx}+\frac12w_x^2=0$, and Hopf--Cole gives \[ u(x,t)=\frac{\displaystyle \int _\R \frac{x-y}{t} e^{-|x-y|^2/(4at)-h(y)/(2a)}\, dy}{\displaystyle \int _\R e^{-|x-y|^2/(4at)-h(y)/(2a)}\, dy}. \] \end{example}
